planets.name: KELT-24 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KELT-24 with a 5.55-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: KELT-24 b was found in 2019 by KELT-North as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KELT-24. Its orbit and size follow Giovinazzi et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
